name: SenClaw Ontology
description: Drop in any file — CSV, TSV, Excel, JSON (nested or wrapped), JSON Lines, YAML, XML, Word, PDF, HTML, Markdown or plain prose — and get a real knowledge graph out. One ✨ Auto-build runs the whole discipline for you: profile the sources, draft the competency questions, design the ontology (T-Box), author a declarative RML-lite mapping and mechanically repair it against your real columns, lift rows into RDF, extract triples from documents, validate with SHACL, answer the competency suite and materialize RDFS/OWL-RL inferences. Then just ask in plain language — you get an answer with the SPARQL and rows behind it. ◆ AIP Assist is a context-aware RAG sidebar you can open from any tab: it indexes the platform documentation plus this project's metadata (sources, columns, classes, properties, mapping, constraints, lineage) and re-ranks answers by the tab you are on and the source you have open, citing every passage it used — and it deliberately holds no cell values, so questions about actual data are handed off to Ask. ⚙️ AIP Logic lets an LLM propose TYPED ACTIONS on the ontology (add entity, set attribute, add relation, link entities) that are type-checked against the schema before they can become triples; every edit lands in a human-in-the-loop proposal queue and is applied only on approval as a droppable provenance batch — extract facts from documents or classify each row of a source at scale, with trial runs and evals. Every triple is provenance-tracked in per-import named graphs you can drop and reload, and every stage stays editable by hand. Backed by an embedded Oxigraph triple store; all AI actions run on SenClaw's configured LLM.

mcp.name: ontology-mcp
mcp.description: SenClaw Ontology MCP: build knowledge graphs from raw data of any format. ontology_ingest auto-detects CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL/YAML/XML/Markdown/HTML/prose and profiles it; ontology_autobuild runs the entire pipeline in one call (T-Box, mapping + repair, lift, extraction, SHACL, competency suite, reasoning); ontology_ask answers questions in plain language with the SPARQL and rows attached; ontology_assist is a context-aware RAG over platform docs + project metadata (metadata only, never data values) that takes the user's current tab as context and answers with citations. Also exposes every stage individually: T-Box editing, mapping DSL, provenance batches, entity resolution, validation and reasoning.
